title: autotune: add sensible defaults for batching/caching, quant profiles and unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: We want to reduce serving unit economics by applying conservative defaults for batching and KV cache use, surface quantization profiles per model family, and add a minimal unit-econ CLI/tooling integration to make recommended config changes actionable. Motivation: customers repeatedly request better out-of-the-box cost behavior without manual tuning and the autotune service should provide safe defaults and recommendations. Changes: 1) add config defaults and heuristics to the autotune service for per-route batching_window_ms, max_batch_tokens, and auto_cache_prefixes derived from route-level latency SLOs and observed seq length distributions; 2) introduce quant_profiles.yaml and associated loader to suggest FP16/int8/4bit profiles by model family and target latency/cost tiers; 3) add unit-econ CLI (redwood-uecon) that can query current route metrics and propose one-click PRs with recommended config changes; 4) add telemetry: unit_econ.suggested_change and autotune.applied_defaults metrics + alerts; 5) docs and examples. Rollout plan: feature-flagged via autotune.enable_defaults per-tenant, staged canary on Dedicated, default-off for Hosted for first 2 weeks. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-4122) - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests against bench lab - [x] e2e smoke - [x] docs and example - [x] telemetry and dashboards
